provenance: Exported from the Source wall (GET /api/coverage/source-wall) of a fresh copy of resmon on October 27, 2026, after four searches of the public sources: the three shown first, and the CRISPR search recorded in the tour. Nothing in it is edited.

verdict.headline: Semantic Scholar has not answered in the 1 of the last 4 runs that recorded an outcome for it.
detail: Zenodo and bioRxiv answered when last asked and are no longer in the most recent run's saved selection.

legend.label: answered
legend.meaning: The source replied and returned records.

legend.label: answered, zero
legend.meaning: The source replied and genuinely had nothing. A quiet field, not a fault.

legend.label: could not be asked
legend.meaning: No key, retired, no author query, or a window the source cannot answer.

legend.label: failed
legend.meaning: The source was asked and the exchange broke.

legend.label: outcome not recorded
legend.meaning: resmon did not observe an outcome. This is not a success and not a failure.

legend.label: not asked on this run
legend.meaning: This run's saved selection did not name this source. Nothing was asked of it.
